description: Validate argument / nested-block paths against the PINNED schema before writing them, e.g. ["bucket", "region", "versioning.enabled"]. Flags unknown, read-only and deprecated paths.

dir.description: Terraform root module directory (must already be initialized). Default: TERRAFORM_CWD_MCP_DIR, else the server's working directory.
